d: The global jobs crisis is deepening as corporate giants slash thousands of positions amid restructuring, cost-cutting and growing pressure to improve performance. Qualcomm is preparing global job cuts, Barclays plans around 5,000 reductions, eBay is eliminating approximately 1,000 roles, and Xbox faces fresh layoffs under Microsoft. Amazon and Netflix are also linked to reported workforce cuts. With nearly 200,000 tech employees affected by layoffs in 2026 so far, questions are mounting about AI, productivity and job security. Are efficiency gains benefiting businesses at workers’ expense?…
